mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for dry rot repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience specifically in dry rot remediation and structural wood repair. Verify their licenses, insurance, and ask for references. A good contractor will conduct a thorough inspection to provide an accurate assessment and detailed repair plan. A practical tradeoff is comparing a contractor's immediate availability with their reputation for comprehensive work; choosing a reputable firm might mean a slightly longer wait but typically results in a more reliable and lasting repair.
